namespace = jip_mishpacha_contract

# Generated by make_contract_events.py. Events for the Mishpacha contracts (common/task_contracts/jip_mishpacha_contracts.txt).
# Event contracts (loan, tolls, physician, responsum):
#   .00X0, a few months after the contract is taken: the family head picks an approach. The outcome is rolled then
#   (jip_contract_choose_approach_effect) and shown as odds in the tooltip.
#   .00X1, a few days later: what came of it, and the contract is completed (jip_contract_finish_effect).
# Scheme contracts (caravan, envoy, ransom, translate, news), like vanilla contract schemes:
#   .00X0, on acceptance: the approach picks the scheme type (its skill), its agents and its modifiers.
#   Executing the scheme from vanilla's preparations window (scheme_critical_moments.0002) fires .00X2, which rolls
#   the scheme's success chance and fires .00X3 (success window) or .00X4 (failure window), which complete it.
# root = the family head
# scope:task_contract = the contract
# scope:employer = its employer
# scope:jip_contract_target = the other character it is about, if any
# scope:scheme = the contract scheme, for scheme contracts

# The Debt Falls Due (loan): choose an approach
jip_mishpacha_contract.0010 = {
	type = character_event
	title = jip_mishpacha_contract.0010.t
	desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0010.desc
	theme = stewardship_wealth_focus
	left_portrait = {
		character = root
		animation = steward
	}
	right_portrait = {
		character = scope:employer
		animation = worry
	}

	trigger = { jip_mishpacha_contract_event_trigger = yes }

	immediate = { jip_mishpacha_contract_event_scopes_effect = yes }

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0010.a
		custom_tooltip = jip_mishpacha_contract.0010.a.tt
		jip_contract_choose_approach_effect = { SKILL = diplomacy BONUS = 0 APPROACH = courtesy EVENT = jip_mishpacha_contract.0011 }
	}

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0010.b
		custom_tooltip = jip_mishpacha_contract.0010.b.tt
		jip_contract_choose_approach_effect = { SKILL = stewardship BONUS = 10 APPROACH = goods EVENT = jip_mishpacha_contract.0011 }
	}

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0010.c
		custom_tooltip = jip_mishpacha_contract.0010.c.tt
		jip_contract_choose_approach_effect = { SKILL = intrigue BONUS = 0 APPROACH = pressure EVENT = jip_mishpacha_contract.0011 }
	}

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0010.d
		custom_tooltip = jip_mishpacha_contract.0010.d.tt
		scope:task_contract = { complete_task_contract = jip_contract_loan_forgiven }
	}
}

jip_mishpacha_contract.0011 = {
	type = character_event
	title = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = critical } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0011.t.critical
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = success } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0011.t.success
			}
			desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0011.t.failure
		}
	}
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_approach_is_trigger = { APPROACH = courtesy } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0011.courtesy
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_approach_is_trigger = { APPROACH = goods } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0011.goods
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_approach_is_trigger = { APPROACH = pressure } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0011.pressure
			}
			desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0011.pressure
		}
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = critical } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0011.critical
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = success } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0011.success
			}
			desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0011.failure
		}
	}
	theme = stewardship_wealth_focus
	left_portrait = {
		character = root
		triggered_animation = {
			trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = critical } }
			animation = happiness
		}
		triggered_animation = {
			trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = failure } }
			animation = worry
		}
		animation = personality_content
	}
	right_portrait = {
		character = scope:employer
		triggered_animation = {
			trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = critical } }
			animation = admiration
		}
		triggered_animation = {
			trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = failure } }
			animation = disapproval
		}
		animation = acknowledging
	}

	trigger = { jip_mishpacha_contract_event_trigger = yes }

	immediate = { jip_mishpacha_contract_event_scopes_effect = yes }

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0011.critical.a
		trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = critical } }
		jip_contract_finish_effect = { CONTRACT = loan }
	}

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0011.success.a
		trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = success } }
		jip_contract_finish_effect = { CONTRACT = loan }
	}

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0011.failure.a
		trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = failure } }
		jip_contract_finish_effect = { CONTRACT = loan }
	}
}

# Fitting Out the Caravan (caravan): take the contract on
jip_mishpacha_contract.0030 = {
	type = character_event
	title = jip_mishpacha_contract.0030.t
	desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0030.desc
	theme = silk_road
	left_portrait = {
		character = root
		animation = thinking
	}
	right_portrait = {
		character = scope:employer
		animation = interested
	}

	trigger = { jip_mishpacha_contract_event_trigger = yes }

	immediate = { jip_mishpacha_contract_event_scopes_effect = yes }

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0030.a
		custom_tooltip = jip_mishpacha_contract.0030.a.tt
		custom_tooltip = jip_contract_scheme_stewardship_tt
		custom_tooltip = jip_contract_scheme_agents_success_tt
		start_scheme = {
			type = jip_contract_caravan_stewardship_scheme
			contract = scope:task_contract
			target_character = scope:employer
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:task_contract = {
				set_variable = {
					name = jip_contract_approach
					value = flag:spread
				}
				scheme ?= {
					add_agent_slot = agent_bookkeeper
					add_agent_slot = agent_bookkeeper
					add_agent_slot = agent_outrider
					add_agent_slot = agent_scout
					add_agent_slot = agent_supplier
					add_scheme_modifier = { type = jip_contract_scheme_bonus_15_modifier }
					add_scheme_modifier = { type = jip_contract_scheme_pace_slow_modifier }
				}
			}
		}
		open_view = {
			view = intrigue_window
			player = root
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0030.b
		custom_tooltip = jip_mishpacha_contract.0030.b.tt
		custom_tooltip = jip_contract_scheme_diplomacy_tt
		custom_tooltip = jip_contract_scheme_agents_balanced_tt
		start_scheme = {
			type = jip_contract_caravan_diplomacy_scheme
			contract = scope:task_contract
			target_character = scope:employer
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:task_contract = {
				set_variable = {
					name = jip_contract_approach
					value = flag:communities
				}
				scheme ?= {
					add_agent_slot = agent_bookkeeper
					add_agent_slot = agent_outrider
					add_agent_slot = agent_scout
					add_agent_slot = agent_supplier
					add_agent_slot = agent_planner
				}
			}
		}
		open_view = {
			view = intrigue_window
			player = root
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0030.c
		custom_tooltip = jip_mishpacha_contract.0030.c.tt
		custom_tooltip = jip_contract_scheme_stewardship_tt
		custom_tooltip = jip_contract_scheme_agents_speed_tt
		start_scheme = {
			type = jip_contract_caravan_stewardship_scheme
			contract = scope:task_contract
			target_character = scope:employer
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:task_contract = {
				set_variable = {
					name = jip_contract_approach
					value = flag:desert
				}
				scheme ?= {
					add_agent_slot = agent_bookkeeper
					add_agent_slot = agent_supplier
					add_agent_slot = agent_supplier
					add_agent_slot = agent_planner
					add_agent_slot = agent_planner
					add_scheme_modifier = { type = jip_contract_scheme_malus_15_modifier }
					add_scheme_modifier = { type = jip_contract_scheme_pace_fast_modifier }
				}
			}
		}
		open_view = {
			view = intrigue_window
			player = root
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0030.d
		trigger = { culture = culture:radhanite }
		custom_tooltip = jip_mishpacha_contract.0030.d.tt
		custom_tooltip = jip_contract_scheme_stewardship_tt
		custom_tooltip = jip_contract_scheme_agents_balanced_tt
		start_scheme = {
			type = jip_contract_caravan_stewardship_scheme
			contract = scope:task_contract
			target_character = scope:employer
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:task_contract = {
				set_variable = {
					name = jip_contract_approach
					value = flag:radhanite
				}
				scheme ?= {
					add_agent_slot = agent_bookkeeper
					add_agent_slot = agent_outrider
					add_agent_slot = agent_scout
					add_agent_slot = agent_supplier
					add_agent_slot = agent_planner
					add_scheme_modifier = { type = jip_contract_scheme_bonus_25_modifier }
				}
			}
		}
		open_view = {
			view = intrigue_window
			player = root
		}
	}
}

# Fitting Out the Caravan (caravan): the scheme is executed
jip_mishpacha_contract.0032 = {
	hidden = yes

	trigger = {
		jip_mishpacha_contract_event_trigger = yes
		exists = scope:scheme
	}

	immediate = {
		jip_mishpacha_contract_event_scopes_effect = yes
		jip_contract_roll_scheme_effect = { SUCCESS_EVENT = jip_mishpacha_contract.0033 FAILURE_EVENT = jip_mishpacha_contract.0034 }
	}
}

# Fitting Out the Caravan (caravan): the scheme succeeds
jip_mishpacha_contract.0033 = {
	type = character_event
	window = scheme_successful_event
	title = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = critical } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0031.t.critical
			}
			desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0031.t.success
		}
	}
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_approach_is_trigger = { APPROACH = spread } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0031.spread
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_approach_is_trigger = { APPROACH = communities } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0031.communities
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_approach_is_trigger = { APPROACH = desert } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0031.desert
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_approach_is_trigger = { APPROACH = radhanite } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0031.radhanite
			}
			desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0031.radhanite
		}
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = critical } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0031.critical
			}
			desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0031.success
		}
	}
	theme = silk_road
	center_portrait = {
		character = root
		triggered_animation = {
			trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = critical } }
			animation = happiness
		}
		animation = personality_content
	}
	right_portrait = {
		character = scope:employer
		triggered_animation = {
			trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = critical } }
			animation = admiration
		}
		animation = acknowledging
	}

	trigger = { jip_mishpacha_contract_event_trigger = yes }

	immediate = { jip_mishpacha_contract_event_scopes_effect = yes }

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0031.critical.a
		trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = critical } }
		jip_contract_finish_effect = { CONTRACT = caravan }
		scope:scheme ?= { end_scheme = yes }
	}

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0031.success.a
		trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = success } }
		jip_contract_finish_effect = { CONTRACT = caravan }
		scope:scheme ?= { end_scheme = yes }
	}
}

# Carrying the Terms (envoy): take the contract on
jip_mishpacha_contract.0040 = {
	type = character_event
	title = jip_mishpacha_contract.0040.t
	desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0040.desc
	theme = diplomacy_foreign_affairs_focus
	left_portrait = {
		character = root
		animation = personality_rational
	}
	right_portrait = {
		character = scope:jip_contract_target
		animation = thinking
	}
	lower_right_portrait = scope:employer

	trigger = {
		jip_mishpacha_contract_event_trigger = yes
		exists = scope:task_contract.var:jip_contract_target
	}

	immediate = { jip_mishpacha_contract_event_scopes_effect = yes }

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0040.a
		custom_tooltip = jip_mishpacha_contract.0040.a.tt
		custom_tooltip = jip_contract_scheme_diplomacy_tt
		custom_tooltip = jip_contract_scheme_agents_balanced_tt
		start_scheme = {
			type = jip_contract_envoy_diplomacy_scheme
			contract = scope:task_contract
			target_character = scope:jip_contract_target
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:task_contract = {
				set_variable = {
					name = jip_contract_approach
					value = flag:argue
				}
				scheme ?= {
					add_agent_slot = agent_diplomat
					add_agent_slot = agent_scribe
					add_agent_slot = agent_cleric_success
					add_agent_slot = agent_herald
					add_agent_slot = agent_socialite
				}
			}
		}
		open_view = {
			view = intrigue_window
			player = root
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0040.b
		custom_tooltip = jip_mishpacha_contract.0040.b.tt
		custom_tooltip = jip_contract_scheme_learning_tt
		custom_tooltip = jip_contract_scheme_agents_success_tt
		start_scheme = {
			type = jip_contract_envoy_learning_scheme
			contract = scope:task_contract
			target_character = scope:jip_contract_target
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:task_contract = {
				set_variable = {
					name = jip_contract_approach
					value = flag:law
				}
				scheme ?= {
					add_agent_slot = agent_diplomat
					add_agent_slot = agent_diplomat
					add_agent_slot = agent_scribe
					add_agent_slot = agent_cleric_success
					add_agent_slot = agent_herald
				}
			}
		}
		open_view = {
			view = intrigue_window
			player = root
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0040.c
		trigger = {
			gold >= {
				value = scope:task_contract.var:jip_contract_stake
				multiply = 0.25
			}
		}
		remove_short_term_gold = {
				value = scope:task_contract.var:jip_contract_stake
				multiply = 0.25
			}
		custom_tooltip = jip_mishpacha_contract.0040.c.tt
		custom_tooltip = jip_contract_scheme_diplomacy_tt
		custom_tooltip = jip_contract_scheme_agents_speed_tt
		start_scheme = {
			type = jip_contract_envoy_diplomacy_scheme
			contract = scope:task_contract
			target_character = scope:jip_contract_target
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:task_contract = {
				set_variable = {
					name = jip_contract_approach
					value = flag:gifts
				}
				scheme ?= {
					add_agent_slot = agent_diplomat
					add_agent_slot = agent_herald
					add_agent_slot = agent_herald
					add_agent_slot = agent_socialite
					add_agent_slot = agent_socialite
					add_scheme_modifier = { type = jip_contract_scheme_bonus_25_modifier }
				}
			}
		}
		open_view = {
			view = intrigue_window
			player = root
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0040.d
		custom_tooltip = jip_mishpacha_contract.0040.d.tt
		custom_tooltip = jip_contract_scheme_intrigue_tt
		custom_tooltip = jip_contract_scheme_agents_speed_tt
		start_scheme = {
			type = jip_contract_envoy_intrigue_scheme
			contract = scope:task_contract
			target_character = scope:jip_contract_target
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:task_contract = {
				set_variable = {
					name = jip_contract_approach
					value = flag:leverage
				}
				scheme ?= {
					add_agent_slot = agent_diplomat
					add_agent_slot = agent_herald
					add_agent_slot = agent_herald
					add_agent_slot = agent_socialite
					add_agent_slot = agent_socialite
					add_scheme_modifier = { type = jip_contract_scheme_malus_10_modifier }
				}
			}
		}
		open_view = {
			view = intrigue_window
			player = root
		}
	}
}

# Carrying the Terms (envoy): the scheme is executed
jip_mishpacha_contract.0042 = {
	hidden = yes

	trigger = {
		jip_mishpacha_contract_event_trigger = yes
		exists = scope:scheme
	}

	immediate = {
		jip_mishpacha_contract_event_scopes_effect = yes
		jip_contract_roll_scheme_effect = { SUCCESS_EVENT = jip_mishpacha_contract.0043 FAILURE_EVENT = jip_mishpacha_contract.0044 }
	}
}

# Carrying the Terms (envoy): the scheme succeeds
jip_mishpacha_contract.0043 = {
	type = character_event
	window = scheme_successful_event
	title = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = critical } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0041.t.critical
			}
			desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0041.t.success
		}
	}
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_approach_is_trigger = { APPROACH = argue } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0041.argue
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_approach_is_trigger = { APPROACH = law } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0041.law
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_approach_is_trigger = { APPROACH = gifts } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0041.gifts
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_approach_is_trigger = { APPROACH = leverage } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0041.leverage
			}
			desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0041.leverage
		}
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = critical } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0041.critical
			}
			desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0041.success
		}
	}
	theme = diplomacy_foreign_affairs_focus
	center_portrait = {
		character = root
		triggered_animation = {
			trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = critical } }
			animation = happiness
		}
		animation = personality_content
	}
	right_portrait = {
		character = scope:jip_contract_target
		triggered_animation = {
			trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = critical } }
			animation = admiration
		}
		animation = acknowledging
	}

	trigger = {
		jip_mishpacha_contract_event_trigger = yes
		exists = scope:task_contract.var:jip_contract_target
	}

	immediate = { jip_mishpacha_contract_event_scopes_effect = yes }

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0041.critical.a
		trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = critical } }
		jip_contract_finish_effect = { CONTRACT = envoy }
		scope:scheme ?= { end_scheme = yes }
	}

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0041.success.a
		trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = success } }
		jip_contract_finish_effect = { CONTRACT = envoy }
		scope:scheme ?= { end_scheme = yes }
	}
}

		character = root
		animation = personality_compassionate
	}
	right_portrait = {
		character = scope:employer
		animation = personality_greedy
	}
	lower_right_portrait = scope:jip_contract_target

		jip_mishpacha_contract_event_trigger = yes
		exists = scope:task_contract.var:jip_contract_target
	}

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0050.a
		custom_tooltip = jip_mishpacha_contract.0050.a.tt
		custom_tooltip = jip_contract_scheme_diplomacy_tt
		custom_tooltip = jip_contract_scheme_agents_balanced_tt
		start_scheme = {
			type = jip_contract_ransom_diplomacy_scheme
			contract = scope:task_contract
			target_character = scope:employer
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:task_contract = {
				set_variable = {
					name = jip_contract_approach
					value = flag:haggle
				}
				scheme ?= {
					add_agent_slot = agent_diplomat
					add_agent_slot = agent_cleric_success
					add_agent_slot = agent_scribe
					add_agent_slot = agent_herald
					add_agent_slot = agent_socialite
				}
			}
		}
		open_view = {
			view = intrigue_window
			player = root
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0050.b
		custom_tooltip = jip_mishpacha_contract.0050.b.tt
		custom_tooltip = jip_contract_scheme_learning_tt
		custom_tooltip = jip_contract_scheme_agents_success_tt
		start_scheme = {
			type = jip_contract_ransom_learning_scheme
			contract = scope:task_contract
			target_character = scope:employer
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:task_contract = {
				set_variable = {
					name = jip_contract_approach
					value = flag:mercy
				}
				scheme ?= {
					add_agent_slot = agent_diplomat
					add_agent_slot = agent_diplomat
					add_agent_slot = agent_cleric_success
					add_agent_slot = agent_scribe
					add_agent_slot = agent_herald
					add_scheme_modifier = { type = jip_contract_scheme_bonus_10_modifier }
				}
			}
		}
		open_view = {
			view = intrigue_window
			player = root
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0050.c
		trigger = { gold >= scope:task_contract.var:jip_contract_stake }
		custom_tooltip = jip_mishpacha_contract.0050.c.tt
		scope:task_contract = { complete_task_contract = jip_contract_ransom_paid }
	}
}

		hidden_effect = {
			scope:task_contract = {
				set_variable = {
					name = jip_contract_approach
					value = flag:language
				}
				scheme ?= {
					add_agent_slot = agent_scribe
					add_agent_slot = agent_theologian
					add_agent_slot = agent_theologian
					add_agent_slot = agent_planner
					add_agent_slot = agent_planner
					add_scheme_modifier = { type = jip_contract_scheme_bonus_20_modifier }
				}
			}
		}
		open_view = {
			view = intrigue_window
			player = root
		}
	}
}

# A Book to Render (translate): the scheme is executed
jip_mishpacha_contract.0072 = {
	hidden = yes

	trigger = {
		jip_mishpacha_contract_event_trigger = yes
		exists = scope:scheme
	}

	immediate = {
		jip_mishpacha_contract_event_scopes_effect = yes
		jip_contract_roll_scheme_effect = { SUCCESS_EVENT = jip_mishpacha_contract.0073 FAILURE_EVENT = jip_mishpacha_contract.0074 }
	}
}

# A Book to Render (translate): the scheme succeeds
jip_mishpacha_contract.0073 = {
	type = character_event
	window = scheme_successful_event
	title = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = critical } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0071.t.critical
			}
			desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0071.t.success
		}
	}
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_approach_is_trigger = { APPROACH = literal } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0071.literal
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_approach_is_trigger = { APPROACH = courtly } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0071.courtly
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_approach_is_trigger = { APPROACH = commentary } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0071.commentary
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_approach_is_trigger = { APPROACH = language } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0071.language
			}
			desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0071.language
		}
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = critical } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0071.critical
			}
			desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0071.success
		}
	}
	theme = learning_scholarship_focus
	center_portrait = {
		character = root
		triggered_animation = {
			trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = critical } }
			animation = happiness
		}
		animation = personality_content
	}
	right_portrait = {
		character = scope:employer
		triggered_animation = {
			trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = critical } }
			animation = admiration
		}
		animation = acknowledging
	}

	trigger = { jip_mishpacha_contract_event_trigger = yes }

	immediate = { jip_mishpacha_contract_event_scopes_effect = yes }

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0071.critical.a
		trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = critical } }
		jip_contract_finish_effect = { CONTRACT = translate }
		scope:scheme ?= { end_scheme = yes }
	}

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0071.success.a
		trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = success } }
		jip_contract_finish_effect = { CONTRACT = translate }
		scope:scheme ?= { end_scheme = yes }
	}
}

# A Question of Law (responsum): choose an approach
jip_mishpacha_contract.0080 = {
	type = character_event
	title = jip_mishpacha_contract.0080.t
	desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0080.desc
	theme = learning_theology_focus
	left_portrait = {
		character = root
		animation = page_flipping
	}
	right_portrait = {
		character = scope:employer
		animation = thinking
	}

	trigger = { jip_mishpacha_contract_event_trigger = yes }

	immediate = { jip_mishpacha_contract_event_scopes_effect = yes }

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0080.a
		custom_tooltip = jip_mishpacha_contract.0080.a.tt
		jip_contract_choose_approach_effect = { SKILL = learning BONUS = 0 APPROACH = strict EVENT = jip_mishpacha_contract.0081 }
	}

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0080.b
		custom_tooltip = jip_mishpacha_contract.0080.b.tt
		jip_contract_choose_approach_effect = { SKILL = diplomacy BONUS = 10 APPROACH = lenient EVENT = jip_mishpacha_contract.0081 }
	}

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0080.c
		trigger = { domicile ?= { OR = { has_domicile_parameter = jip_estate_beit_din_1 has_domicile_parameter = jip_estate_beit_din_2 } } }
		custom_tooltip = jip_mishpacha_contract.0080.c.tt
		jip_contract_choose_approach_effect = { SKILL = learning BONUS = 20 APPROACH = beit_din EVENT = jip_mishpacha_contract.0081 }
	}
}

# A Question of Law (responsum): the result
jip_mishpacha_contract.0081 = {
	type = character_event
	title = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = critical } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0081.t.critical
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = success } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0081.t.success
			}
			desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0081.t.failure
		}
	}
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_approach_is_trigger = { APPROACH = strict } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0081.strict
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_approach_is_trigger = { APPROACH = lenient } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0081.lenient
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_approach_is_trigger = { APPROACH = beit_din } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0081.beit_din
			}
			desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0081.beit_din
		}
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = critical } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0081.critical
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = success } }
				desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0081.success
			}
			desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0081.failure
		}
	}
	theme = learning_theology_focus
	left_portrait = {
		character = root
		triggered_animation = {
			trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = critical } }
			animation = happiness
		}
		triggered_animation = {
			trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = failure } }
			animation = worry
		}
		animation = personality_content
	}
	right_portrait = {
		character = scope:employer
		triggered_animation = {
			trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = critical } }
			animation = admiration
		}
		triggered_animation = {
			trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = failure } }
			animation = disapproval
		}
		animation = acknowledging
	}

	trigger = { jip_mishpacha_contract_event_trigger = yes }

	immediate = { jip_mishpacha_contract_event_scopes_effect = yes }

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0081.critical.a
		trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = critical } }
		jip_contract_finish_effect = { CONTRACT = responsum }
	}

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0081.success.a
		trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = success } }
		jip_contract_finish_effect = { CONTRACT = responsum }
	}

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0081.failure.a
		trigger = { jip_contract_outcome_is_trigger = { OUTCOME = failure } }
		jip_contract_finish_effect = { CONTRACT = responsum }
	}
}

# Whom to Ask (news): take the contract on
jip_mishpacha_contract.0090 = {
	type = character_event
	title = jip_mishpacha_contract.0090.t
	desc = jip_mishpacha_contract.0090.desc
	theme = intrigue_skulduggery_focus
	left_portrait = {
		character = root
		animation = scheme
	}
	right_portrait = {
		character = scope:employer
		animation = interested
	}
	lower_right_portrait = scope:jip_contract_target

	trigger = {
		jip_mishpacha_contract_event_trigger = yes
		exists = scope:task_contract.var:jip_contract_target
	}

	immediate = { jip_mishpacha_contract_event_scopes_effect = yes }

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0090.a
		custom_tooltip = jip_mishpacha_contract.0090.a.tt
		custom_tooltip = jip_contract_scheme_stewardship_tt
		custom_tooltip = jip_contract_scheme_agents_balanced_tt
		start_scheme = {
			type = jip_contract_news_stewardship_scheme
			contract = scope:task_contract
			target_character = scope:jip_contract_target
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:task_contract = {
				set_variable = {
					name = jip_contract_approach
					value = flag:merchants
				}
				scheme ?= {
					add_agent_slot = agent_scribe
					add_agent_slot = agent_bookkeeper
					add_agent_slot = agent_diplomat
					add_agent_slot = agent_infiltrator
					add_agent_slot = agent_socialite
				}
			}
		}
		open_view = {
			view = intrigue_window
			player = root
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0090.b
		custom_tooltip = jip_mishpacha_contract.0090.b.tt
		custom_tooltip = jip_contract_scheme_diplomacy_tt
		custom_tooltip = jip_contract_scheme_agents_success_tt
		start_scheme = {
			type = jip_contract_news_diplomacy_scheme
			contract = scope:task_contract
			target_character = scope:jip_contract_target
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:task_contract = {
				set_variable = {
					name = jip_contract_approach
					value = flag:communities
				}
				scheme ?= {
					add_agent_slot = agent_scribe
					add_agent_slot = agent_scribe
					add_agent_slot = agent_bookkeeper
					add_agent_slot = agent_diplomat
					add_agent_slot = agent_infiltrator
				}
			}
		}
		open_view = {
			view = intrigue_window
			player = root
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = jip_mishpacha_contract.0090.c
		trigger = {
			gold >= {
				value = scope:task_contract.var:jip_contract_stake
				multiply = 0.25
			}
		}
		remove_short_term_gold = {
				value = scope:task_contract.var:jip_contract_stake
				multiply = 0.25
			}
		custom_tooltip = jip_mishpacha_contract.0090.c.tt
		custom_tooltip = jip_contract_scheme_intrigue_tt
		custom_tooltip = jip_contract_scheme_agents_speed_tt
		start_scheme = {
			type = jip_contract_news_intrigue_scheme
			contract = scope:task_contract
			target_character = scope:jip_contract_target
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:task_contract = {
				set_variable = {
					name = jip_contract_approach
					value = flag:clerk
				}
				scheme ?= {
					add_agent_slot = agent_scribe
					add_agent_slot = agent_infiltrator
					add_agent_slot = agent_infiltrator
					add_agent_slot = agent_socialite
					add_agent_slot = agent_socialite
					add_scheme_modifier = { type = jip_contract_scheme_bonus_15_modifier }
				}
			}
		}
		open_view = {
			view = intrigue_window
			player = root
		}
	}
}
